verdict.rationale: Docs show a human-in-the-loop approval mechanism via 'deferred tools' (tools requiring approval or external execution) and mention a coding-agent CLI with 'workspace-rooted file access, allowlisted shell', which gives some tool-permission control, but there is no documented sandboxed execution environment (e.g., containerization/isolation) for the core agent framework, and no independent verification of these restrictions in practice. missing for 10: explicit sandboxing/isolation of tool execution, fine-grained per-tool permission scoping beyond approval gating, and hands-on/independent confirmation of these guardrails.
